visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy stands in the center of an indoor bedroom, wearing a black and white horizontally striped t-shirt and khaki pants. He points energetically at the camera with his right hand, his mouth moving as he speaks. The background shows a bed with messy grey pillows and a purple blanket, backed by sleek, minimalist grey-toned cabinetry under bright indoor lighting. (2) The boy begins to dance rhythmically, swinging his arms and swaying his torso with a joyful, focused facial expression. The camera is steady, capturing his upper body as he performs a coordinated routine. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the boy's face; animated red cheek overlays and a small red heart icon appear on the screen to emphasize his cuteness. He smiles broadly, looking off-camera towards someone. (4) The boy stands again, pointing upwards and then at the camera, seemingly announcing the next part of his performance. His posture is confident and playful. (5) He resumes dancing to a different rhythm, primarily using sharp arm movements and hand gestures that mimic the beat of the background music while maintaining consistent eye contact with the lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a young child's high-pitched, enthusiastic voice announcing plans to dance in Traditional Chinese. There is a low ambient room tone but no music initially. (2) A sharp transition occurs as a fast-paced, high-energy electronic J-pop track with strong rhythmic beats begins. The child shouts for music, and the song features male Japanese vocals. The percussion is prominent with a clear, fast-tempo backbeat. (3) The music stops abruptly, replaced by the sound of an adult male laughing off-camera and providing encouraging words. The child speaks again, introducing a new song title. (4) A second high-tempo track starts with a dense synthesizer melody and a heavy electronic drum rhythm. The adult's background laughter and vocal reactions are layered over the music, creating a casual, social atmosphere. The child's rhythmic breathing and occasional grunts of effort are audible during the dance segments.
